name: Mephisto
description: Fan-made scenario pack by Neptune (Typhon00): a battle for your soul against Mephisto, with the Blackheart, Corruptive Offers, Damned and Mother of Demons encounter sets and new art for the Standard and Expert sets.

permission.evidence: Screenshot of the creator's message, shared by the owner: his content "is free to play, download, print, what have you". Given 2026-11-02 by direct message to the community member Dreadheart; confirmed by the owner 2026-11-12.
permission.scope: inclusion in the game and its Mod Store
